# encodeHtml

<link-summary>Encodes every character as a numeric character reference.</link-summary>

<web-summary>encodeHtml() — Encodes every character as a numeric character reference. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>html</code> · Since: 1.0.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function encodeHtml(value: string): string;
```

Unlike `escapeHtml`, which touches only the five dangerous characters, this rewrites the whole string as `&#NN;` references. `decodeHtml` is its inverse.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type     | Description                                  |
| :-------- | :------- | :------------------------------------------- |
| `value`   | `string` | The string to convert. It must not be empty. |

## Returns

`string` — the encoded string.

## Throws

| Exception              | Condition                               |
| :--------------------- | :-------------------------------------- |
| `EmptyStringException` | the value is not a string, or is empty. |

## Examples

### Converting

```javascript
encodeHtml("<a>"); // => "&#60;a&#62;"
```
